frequency_question: What proportion of proposed national transport/automotive manufacturing support schemes that reach a visible signal state are formally finalized and implemented within 12 months?
membership_rule: Includes central government automotive/transport manufacturing financial incentive schemes, subsidies, or credit guarantee policies that reached draft or announced consultation stages; excludes minor amendments to existing schemes.

cases.name: Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of Hybrid and Electric Vehicles (FAME II) rollout
Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Automobile and Auto Component Industry
PLI Scheme for Advanced Chemistry Cell (ACC) Battery Storage

Draft PM E-Drive Scheme successor framework

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named major schemes; universe of explicitly signalled central automotive subsidy schemes in this jurisdiction shows near-100 percent conversion once advanced signals are visible.
known_gaps: Minor state-level variations or abandoned preliminary committee notes not elevated to formal ministry drafts are excluded.
skeleton: 6 historical major national EV and automotive financial support schemes tracked from advance signals to implementation over the past decade.
multiplier: 6 hits out of 6 observed distinct major initiatives
validity_reason: Policy momentum and strategic prioritization surrounding EV manufacturing and decarbonization frameworks remain stable under current administrative structures through the medium term.
